sso.seoDescription: Configure enterprise SSO for your organization
sso.title: Single Sign-On
sso.subtitle: Allow your team to sign in with their corporate identity provider (Okta, Azure AD, Google Workspace, etc.).
sso.redirectUriLabel: Redirect URI (add this in your IdP):
sso.emptyDescription: Connect your corporate identity provider so your team can sign in with their work accounts — no separate passwords needed.
sso.emailDomainHint: Users with this email domain will be routed to this SSO provider.
sso.issuerUrlHintPrefix: The OIDC issuer URL. Matriq will auto-discover endpoints from
sso.providerIdHint: A unique slug for this provider. Lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only.
sso.clientSecretHint: Stored encrypted. Never exposed in the UI after saving.
sso.setupStep1: Create an OIDC application in your identity provider (Okta, Azure AD, Google Workspace, etc.).
sso.setupStep3: Copy the Client ID and Client Secret from your IdP and paste them above.
sso.setupStep4: Enter the Issuer URL — Matriq will auto-discover all OIDC endpoints.
sso.howItWorksStep1: You register your company's identity provider (IdP) — Okta, Azure AD, Google Workspace, or any OIDC-compliant provider.
sso.howItWorksStep2: Team members visit the sign-in page and enter their work email. Matriq detects the email domain and redirects to your IdP.
sso.howItWorksStep3: After authenticating with the IdP, users are automatically provisioned into your organization as members — no invitation needed.
sso.registerSuccess: SSO provider registered successfully. Your team can now sign in with their corporate credentials.
